name: CES 556 醉客不理性乱秩序 氧气面罩 灭火器

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 556, from Seoul to Wuhan, you are maintaining 9200 meters, approaching Juliet Tango November, squawking 1532, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 556，从首尔飞往武汉，保持 9200 米，接近 Juliet Tango November，应答机 1532，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES556, maintaining 9200 meters, approaching JTN, squawking 1532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES556，保持 9200 米，接近 JTN，应答机 1532。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, direct to Tango Oscar Lima, reduce speed to Mach 0.79.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，直飞 Tango Oscar Lima，减速至马赫 0.79。
cards.referenceText: Direct to TOL, reduce speed to M.79, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 TOL，减速至 M.79，CES556。

cards.audioText: B: Near Tango Oscar Lima, you are experiencing moderate to severe clear air turbulence between 6000 meters and 10400 meters, contact Shanghai Control and request climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B：在 Tango Oscar Lima 附近，你在 6000 米至 10400 米之间遭遇中到强晴空颠簸，联系上海管制并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES556, we are experiencing moderate to severe clear air turbulence between 6000 meters and 10400 meters, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES556，我们在 6000 米至 10400 米之间遭遇中到强晴空颠簸，请求爬升。

cards.audioText:
C: China Eastern 556, the alternative level is 11600 meters, what's your intention?
B: Tell the controller you can accept 11600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 556，备选高度为 11600 米，你的意图？
B：告诉管制员你可以接受 11600 米。
cards.referenceText: We can accept 11600 meters, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们可以接受 11600 米，CES556。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, climb to and maintain 11600 meters, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，爬升并保持 11600 米，报告到达。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11600 meters, report reaching, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 11600 米，报告到达，CES556。

cards.audioText: B: You receive the report from the cabin that a drunk passenger is behaving irrationally, affecting cabin services and disturbing cabin order, you suspect the higher cabin altitude is making passengers uncomfortable, you want to fly lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你收到客舱报告，一名醉酒旅客行为异常，影响客舱服务并扰乱客舱秩序，你怀疑较高客舱高度让旅客不适，想飞较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES556, a drunk passenger is behaving irrationally, affecting cabin services and disturbing cabin order, we suspect the higher cabin altitude is making passengers uncomfortable, request descent to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES556，一名醉酒旅客行为异常，影响客舱服务并扰乱客舱秩序，我们怀疑较高客舱高度让旅客不适，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, maintain 11600 meters due to airspace congestion, reduce speed to Mach 0.75.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，因空域拥挤，保持 11600 米，减速至马赫 0.75。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 11600 meters, reduce speed to M.75, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 11600 米，减速至 M.75，CES556。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, contact Wuhan Control on 128.55.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，联系武汉管制128.55。

cards.audioText: B: The flight attendant reported 2 passengers took out their overhead oxygen masks, they are being closely monitored, report it to Wuhan Control and request descent now.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务员报告 2 名旅客取出了头顶氧气面罩，他们正被严密监控，向武汉管制报告并请求立即下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES556, the flight attendant reported 2 passengers took out their overhead oxygen masks, they are being closely monitored, request descent now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES556，乘务员报告 2 名旅客取出了头顶氧气面罩，他们正被严密监控，请求立即下降。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, descend to 6600 meters and level by X-Ray Sierra Hotel.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，下降至 6600 米，并在 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 前改平。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 6600 meters and level by XSH, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6600 米，并在 XSH 前改平，CES556。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, due to temporary airspace restriction is effective immediately, after passing X-Ray Sierra Hotel, follow Zulu Foxtrot 03 Alpha arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，因临时空域限制立即生效，过 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 后，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 03 Alpha 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: After passing XSH, follow ZF 03A arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过 XSH 后，执行 ZF 03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES556。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, contact Wuhan Approach 120.4.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，联系武汉进近120.4。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over Zulu Foxtrot, maintaining 6600 meters, you have got information Oscar, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 Zulu Foxtrot 上空，保持 6600 米，已收到通播 Oscar，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES556, over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, information O.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES556，ZF 上空，保持 6600 米，通播 O。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, information is Papa, descend and maintain 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，武汉进近，雷达识别，通播是 Papa，下降并保持 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, information P, descend and maintain 4200 meters, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，通播 P，下降并保持 4200 米，CES556。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar observed a cumuliform clouds ahead, contact Wuhan Approach and request turn left and track direct to Hotel Golf.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达观察到前方积状云，联系武汉进近并请求左转直飞 Hotel Golf。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES556, our weather radar observed CB ahead, request turn left and track direct to HG.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES556，我们的气象雷达观察到前方 CB，请求左转并直飞 HG。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES556。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES556。

cards.audioText: B: While intercepting the localizer, 1 drunk passenger discharged the fire extinguisher, the purser make an emergency call said there are still passengers standing in the cabin, inform Wuhan Approach the situation and request terminate approach and proceed to holding area.
cards.audioTextZh: B：截获航向道时，1 名醉酒旅客释放了灭火器，乘务长紧急呼叫称客舱仍有旅客站立，通知武汉进近该情况并请求终止进近，前往等待区。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES556, 1 drunk passenger discharged the fire extinguisher, there are still passengers standing in the cabin, request terminate approach and proceed to holding area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES556，1 名醉酒旅客释放了灭火器，客舱仍有旅客站立，请求终止进近并前往等待区。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, turn left, direct to Delta Alpha, climb to 1200 meters, hold as published, expect further clearance at time 50.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，左转，直飞 Delta Alpha，爬升至 1200 米，按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可时间 50。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to DA, climb to 1200 meters, expect further clearance at time 50, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DA，爬升至 1200 米，预计进一步许可时间 50，CES556。

cards.audioText: B: Now the problematic passenger has been properly restrained, advise the Approach controller you are ready to leave the hold.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在问题旅客已被妥善约束，告知进近管制员你准备好离开等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES556, the problematic passenger has been properly restrained, request leave the hold.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES556，问题旅客已被妥善约束，请求离开等待。
